name.description: Shown in the tree. Later fields refer to this one by name.

length.description: For bytes and message: a fixed count, the name of an earlier varint or uint field, or "rest".

expect.description: For bytes: the hex the bytes should be, like "87AFFA87".

names.description: For varint and uint: a typeMaps entry used to show a name next to the number.

message.description: For message: the full message name, like pkg.Message.

messageFrom.description: For message: pick the message type from an earlier field's value.

from.description: For crc32: the first field the CRC covers. It covers everything up to the CRC.

count.description: For repeat: how many times, or an earlier field's name. Leave it out to repeat to the end.

label.description: For repeat: the tree label. {index} and {fieldName} are filled in.

filePatterns.description: Globs for the files this spec decodes, like *.wwproj.

root.description: For plain protobuf files with no layout: the message the whole file holds.

typeMaps.description: Named maps from numbers to message names, or to { name, message }.

bytesTypes.description: Bytes fields that hold a message, keyed by pkg.Message.field. The type comes from a sibling field's value.

from.description: The sibling field, which must come before this one.
